name: Rulers
overview: Scripture reveals that rulers are established by God to exercise dominion over creation, as seen in Genesis 1:26 where man is given authority over the earth. Historical examples such as Nimrod, described as a mighty one on earth (Genesis 10:8), and Melchizedek, a king and priest of the Most High God (Genesis 14:18), illustrate the diverse roles and responsibilities of leadership. The interactions of rulers like Pharaoh with Abraham and Jacob’s family (Genesis 12:15; 15:13) further demonstrate the influence and duties of rulers in God’s sovereign plan.
